research_question: Do identified disclosure regulations generally affect stock-market liquidity, and how do the requirements spread internationally?
recommended_scope: Primary public disclosure; combined public and confidential disclosure and confidential-only results reported separately. Both family weights retained.
current_inference: Public-disclosure spread point estimates are negative under both family weights and horizons. The primary estimates and diagnostics do not establish a general causal liquidity improvement. Diffusion associations are conditional and sensitive to common family waves.

next_steps.evidence_gap: The 482 recorded country-family histories identify documented phases, not a verified census of first mandatory disclosure and nonadoption. Unknown histories narrow the comparison sample.
next_steps.deliverable: Country-family-year calendar with original legal sources, earliest mandatory/public dates, subsequent phases, repeal and verified nonadoption through the observation window. Separate E, S and G obligations and publication audiences.
next_steps.completion_criterion: Every treated and comparison country-year in the proposed main sample has a reviewed historical status and a source-supported date. Unresolved histories remain missing, never assumed untreated.

next_steps.task: Identify when investors could first receive the information
next_steps.evidence_gap: Announcement, first covered financial period, statutory filing deadline and actual publication are different events. The global calendar currently has no company-level actual filing dates.
next_steps.deliverable: Separate legal announcement, application, reporting-period, deadline and public-release clocks; verify transitions against issuer reports and registry records where available.
next_steps.completion_criterion: The main information clock is chosen for its institutional meaning before refitting; alternative clocks and coverage attrition are reported on comparable samples.

next_steps.evidence_gap: Fixed cohorts and not-yet-treated comparisons do not resolve policy endogeneity, coordinated adoption waves, overlapping reforms or pre-policy differences. Matching retains material imbalance.
next_steps.deliverable: An institutional identification memo, overlap and coordinated-wave map, credible comparison sample, and an estimator appropriate to the verified staggered timing. If a narrow eligibility threshold or externally imposed implementation shock exists, document it rather than assume one.
next_steps.completion_criterion: A defensible counterfactual and clustered inference match the legal assignment mechanism. Event dynamics, balance, trend-sensitivity restrictions and alternative outcomes are evaluated without selecting by sign.

next_steps.task: Extend mechanism tests on adequate global support
next_steps.evidence_gap: The current spread interactions have only two supported public families. A country-level regulator-quality proxy is not firm-level enforcement or information demand.
next_steps.deliverable: Pre-specified mechanism predictions with distinct alternatives, global coverage audit and source-linked moderators; issuer eligibility and historical fundamentals if issuer-level tests are used.
next_steps.completion_criterion: Cross-sectional comparisons cover enough independently adopting jurisdictions and families for the claimed population, with formal interaction tests and multiplicity disclosure. No numerical support target is invented as a guarantee of identification.

next_steps.task: Complete diffusion histories and separate common waves
next_steps.evidence_gap: The public-sample reference joint logit has no usable rows. The positive common-year language association changes sign with family-year effects. Observed phase histories are retrospectively selected.
next_steps.deliverable: Complete adoption-risk sets, documented peer universes, coordinated-legal-group exclusions and separately justified learning, competition and emulation measures.
next_steps.completion_criterion: Separate and joint tests retain interpretable outcome variation; conclusions survive relevant common-wave explanations or are explicitly limited to conditional associations.

next_steps.task: Finish independent scholarly review and replication
next_steps.evidence_gap: The literature matrix is a targeted 34-record review, not a systematic full-text review of all cited papers. The public bundle cannot redistribute licensed Datastream inputs.
next_steps.deliverable: Coauthor review of novelty and institutions; complete bibliography and source audit; independent reproduction using documented licensed-input locations and aggregate replication files.
next_steps.completion_criterion: Every central claim maps to a source or table, all exclusions and exploratory choices are disclosed, and an independent reader can reproduce the reported sample and estimates with authorised data access.

submission_claim: No journal acceptance, publishability or submission readiness is asserted.
